title: Diversity Combining for Multi-Path LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.38829v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-path reasoning methods such as self-consistency (SC) sample $K$ reasoning paths and choose the most frequent answer. However, their gains quickly plateau as $K$ increases, and existing methods do not predict when this saturation will occur. We formalize multi-path LLM reasoning as a diversity combining problem from wireless communications: each path is a noisy channel observation, and the pairwise correlation of path correctness caps the design-effect effective sample size of the vote at a finite ceiling. Generalized least squares (GLS) analysis shows that, under exchangeability, the optimal symmetric linear combiner of latent embeddings is uniform, supporting majority vote as the natural default in standard SC while leaving room for weighting or pruning under heterogeneous prompt-template branches. translated_title: 面向多路径大语言模型推理的分集合并方法
translated_abstract: 自一致性（Self-Consistency, SC）等多路径推理方法通过采样K条推理路径并选择出现频率最高的答案。然而，随着K的增大，其收益迅速趋于饱和平台，且现有方法无法预测这种饱和何时出现。我们将多路径大语言模型推理形式化为无线通信中的分集合并问题：每条路径相当于一次含噪的信道观测，而路径正确性之间的两两相关性会将投票的设计效应有效样本量限制在一个有限上限。广义最小二乘（GLS）分析表明，在可交换性条件下，潜在嵌入的最优对称线性合并器是均匀的，这支持多数投票作为标准SC的自然默认选择，同时在异构提示模板分支下为加权或剪枝留出了空间。在5个模型和12个基准测试的实验中，提示模板多样性在57个有效组合中的55个里降低了路径相关性，其效果最强的（后续内容截断）……
tldr: 该论文将多路径LLM推理形式化为无线通信中的分集合并问题，证明了在可交换性条件下多数投票是最优的均匀线性合并策略，并提出通过提示模板多样性降低路径间相关性，从而突破SC方法随采样数增加而收益饱和的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes multi-path LLM reasoning as a diversity combining problem from wireless communications, proving that majority vote is the optimal uniform linear combiner under exchangeability, and shows that prompt-template diversity reduces path correlation to push past SC's saturation ceiling.
